common.footerNote: This message was sent automatically by our online shop. Please do not reply to this address.
common.linkExpiry: This link can be used once, and expires seven days after it was sent.

inquiry.subject: Inquiry
inquiry.preheader: A visitor sent an inquiry through the contact form.
inquiry.heading: New inquiry
inquiry.name: Name

registrationReceived.subject: We received your registration
registrationReceived.preheader: Your registration is with our team.
registrationReceived.heading: Thank you for registering
registrationReceived.body: We have received your registration and passed it to our team.
registrationReceived.nextSteps: A colleague will review it and set up your account. You will receive a second email with your password as soon as it is ready. Until then you cannot sign in yet.

accountApproved.subject: Your account is ready
accountApproved.preheader: Choose a password to start ordering.
accountApproved.heading: Your account is ready
accountApproved.body: Your registration has been approved and your customer account is set up. Choose a password and you can start ordering right away.

accountCreated.subject: An account has been created for you
accountCreated.preheader: Choose a password to start ordering.
accountCreated.heading: An account has been created for you
accountCreated.body: We have set up a customer account for you at our online shop. Choose a password and you can start ordering right away.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.preheader: Choose a new password for your account.
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: Someone asked to reset the password for your customer account. Choose a new one and you can sign in again straight away.
passwordReset.expiry: This link can be used once, and expires an hour after it was sent.
passwordReset.ignore: If this was not you, you can ignore this message — your password stays as it is, and nobody can use this link without your mailbox.

accountDeleted.subject: Your account has been deleted
accountDeleted.preheader: Your customer account and personal details have been removed.
accountDeleted.heading: Your account has been deleted
accountDeleted.body: Your customer account is closed and your personal details have been removed from our records. This email address is no longer connected to an account with us.
accountDeleted.orders: Past orders are kept for our bookkeeping, with your details removed from them. If you register again later, it will be a new account — your earlier orders will not appear in it.

newRegistration.subject: New registration
newRegistration.heading: New registration
newRegistration.body: Someone has requested a customer account. Review the request and, if it is genuine, approve it and assign the customer a price tier.

orderReceived.subject: We have your order request
orderReceived.preheader: Your order request has reached us.
orderReceived.heading: Thank you — we have your order
orderReceived.body: Your order request {reference} has reached us. Nothing is charged and nothing is dispatched yet.
orderReceived.nextSteps: We will confirm the details, the delivery and the price with you shortly. You can open your order with the link below at any time.

newOrder.subject: New order request
newOrder.preheader: A customer has sent an order request.
newOrder.heading: New order request
newOrder.body: A customer has sent an order request. Open it to check the lines and the price, then confirm it with them.

orderCancelled.subject: Order called off
orderCancelled.preheader: A customer has called off their order.
orderCancelled.heading: Order called off
orderCancelled.body: A customer has called off an order that was still waiting for an answer. Nothing more is expected of you — but if anything was already set aside for it, it can go back on the shelf.
orderCancelled.paidNote: A payment is recorded against this order. Any refund is arranged with the customer directly — nothing here moves money.

accountClosed.subject: A customer closed their account
accountClosed.preheader: A customer has closed their account.
accountClosed.heading: Account closed
accountClosed.body: A customer has closed their account. Their details are gone; their past orders were kept for the books, with everything identifying removed from them.
accountClosed.openOrdersNote: {count} of those orders have not ended yet. They are still yours to settle, and they can no longer be traced back to a customer — so check them before anything else.

orderStatusChanged.subject: Your order
orderStatusChanged.preheader: There is news about your order.
orderStatusChanged.changedIntro: We have changed this order since we last wrote to you — what we changed is noted below, and the contents and total are the ones that now apply.
orderStatusChanged.correctedIntro: We have corrected our record of this order: it had moved further along than it should have. Where it now stands is below.
orderStatusChanged.attachedNote: Our payment details for this order are attached to this message.

changed.heading: We have changed your order
changed.body: Where your order stands has not changed — its contents and total have. The ones below are the ones that now apply.

reopened.heading: Your order is back with us
reopened.body: We have put your order back in our queue and will come back to you about it shortly. Anything we told you about it before no longer applies.

approved.heading: Your order is confirmed
approved.body: We have confirmed your order. We will let you know as soon as it is ready.

readyDelivery.heading: Your order is on its way
readyDelivery.body: Your order has left us for delivery to the address below.

readyPickup.heading: Your order is ready to collect
readyPickup.body: Your order is packed and waiting at the pickup location below. Please bring your order number.

completed.heading: Your order is complete
completed.body: Your order is finished. Thank you — we look forward to the next one.

declined.heading: We cannot fill this order
declined.body: We are sorry: we are unable to fill this order. The reason is below, and you are welcome to call us about it.

cancelled.heading: Your order has been cancelled
cancelled.body: This order has been cancelled and will not be filled. The reason is below, and you are welcome to call us about it.

orderDocument.subject: A document for your order
orderDocument.preheader: There is a document with your order.

paymentInstructions.heading: How to pay for your order
paymentInstructions.body: Our payment details for this order are attached. Nothing about the order itself has changed.

orderSummary.heading: A copy of your order
orderSummary.body: We have put a copy of your order with it, which you can open from the link below. Nothing about the order itself has changed.

orderSummaryPdf.title: Order {reference}
orderSummaryPdf.footer: This document states the order as it stands. It is not an invoice.

reasons.policy: Its effect is larger than an automatic update is allowed to be
reasons.requested: The source asked for it to be reviewed

failed.subject: Catalog update failed
failed.preheader: An automatic catalog update did not go through.
failed.heading: An automatic catalog update failed
failed.body: Your catalog is unchanged and the shop is serving what it served before. Until this is fixed, prices and stock will slowly go out of date — pass this message on to whoever looks after the connection to your system.

recovered.subject: Catalog updates are working again
recovered.preheader: The automatic catalog update went through.
recovered.heading: Catalog updates are working again
recovered.body: The connection to your system is delivering again, and your catalog is up to date. Nothing was lost in the meantime: an update carries the current state rather than a list of changes.

waiting.subject: A catalog update is waiting for you
waiting.preheader: An automatic catalog update needs your decision.
waiting.heading: A catalog update is waiting for you
waiting.body: It has not been applied. Look at what it would change, then apply it or discard it — nothing on the shop moves until you do.

created.subject: New products from your system
created.preheader: An automatic catalog update brought new products.
created.heading: New products arrived
created.body: They are in your catalog but not on the shop: a new product stays off the storefront until you have given it its description and pictures and published it.
